en-e1-l1.title: Alfabheti nenzwi rekutanga
en-e1-l1.concept: Izwi rinorangarirwa nyore kana uchiziva inzwi rekutanga nemavara ekutanga. Verenga uchitaura inzwi.

en-e1-l2.title: Kukwazisana
en-e1-l2.concept: Kana wasangana taura **Hello**, kana uchisiyana taura **Goodbye**. Zita rinotaurwa ne **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Nhamba neruvara
en-e1-l3.concept: Dzidza nhamba one, two, three... nemazwi eruvara red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Mhuri
en-e1-l4.concept: Mazwi ekudaidza nhengo dzemhuri se mother (amai), father (baba), grandmother (ambuya), baby (mwana muduku).

en-e1-l5.title: Mazwi ekirasi
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Taura mazwi anoshandiswa mukirasi muChirungu.

en-e2-l1.title: Mazita emhuka nezvinhu
en-e2-l1.concept: Mazwi anoratidza mazita se rabbit (tsuro), bird (shiri), fish (hove) anonzi **noun**.

en-e2-l2.title: Mazwi anoratidza kufamba
en-e2-l2.concept: Mazwi anoratidza zviito se jump (kuhwarara), run (kumhanya), eat (kudya) anonzi **chiito**.

en-e2-l4.title: Kugadzira mitsara mipfupi
en-e2-l4.concept: Mushure me I shandisa **am**, mushure me You shandisa **are**. Mutsara unotevera kurongeka 'ani → akaita sei/anoita chii'.

en-e2-l5.title: Kuverenga zvinyorwa zvipfupi
en-e2-l5.concept: Pakuverenga, tanga watsvaga mazwi emubvunzo munyaya.

en-e3-abc1.title: Mavara makuru nemadiki ealfabheti
en-e3-abc1.concept: Alfabheti ine **mavara makuru** ne**mavara madiki**. Mapeya mazhinji ane chimiro chakasiyana, saka rangarira peya imwe neimwe. Chenjerera zvikurukuru mavara akafanana se b, d, p, q.

en-e3-l1.title: Kugadzira mitsara
en-e3-l1.concept: Mutsara unotevera kurongeka 'ani → anoita chii → chii'. Pachiito chiri mushure me He, She nemazita evanhu wedzera **-s**.

en-e3-l3.title: Nguva yazvino neyakapfuura
en-e3-l3.concept: Zvinoitika zvino kana zvinodzokororwa shandisa **present**, zvakapfuura shandisa **past** nekuwedzera **-ed** pamagumo echiito.

en-e3-l4.title: Zvinoitwa zuva nezuva
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Taura zvinoitwa zuva nezuva muChirungu.

en-e3-l5.title: Kunzwisisa nyaya
en-e3-l5.concept: Verenga nyaya uye tsvaga kuti ndiani, rinhi, akaita chii.

en-e3-snd1.title: Hukama pakati pezvinzwika nekuperetwa
en-e3-snd1.concept: Inzwi rekutanga nemavara ekutanga ezwi zvine hukama. Dzidza hukama pakati pezvinzwika nekuperetwa nekutsvaga mazwi anotanga neinzwi rimwechete. Dzimwe nguva mavara maviri seph anoita inzwi f.

en-e4-l1.title: Nguva yazvino, yakapfuura neramangwana
en-e4-l1.concept: Zvinoitwa izvozvi nezvinodzokororwa ndi **present tense**, zvakapfuura ndi **-ed**, uye zvichaitwa ndi **will + chiito chekutanga**.

en-e4-l2.title: Mibvunzo nezvinoramba
en-e4-l2.concept: Mibvunzo inotanga ne **Do/Does**, uye kuramba kunoshandisa **don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Mazwi anotsanangura chimiro nemanzwiro
en-e4-l3.concept: Mazwi anotsanangura chimiro kana manzwiro, seku big (hombe), small (diki), hot (inopisa), cold (inotonhora).

en-e4-l5.title: Kuverenga zvinyorwa zvipfupi
en-e4-l5.concept: Tsvaga muchinyorwa kuti ndiani, kupi, nezvakaitwa chii wopindura.

en-e5-l1.title: Articles, mazwi ehuwandu, There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Pamberi pezwi rine inzwi revowel shandisa **an**, pamberi pezwi rine inzwi re consonant shandisa **a**. Kana pane chimwe shandisa **There is**, kana pane zvakawanda shandisa **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Mazwi ekuenzanisa
en-e5-l2.concept: Kuenzanisa zvinhu zviviri shandisa **-er + than**, uye chinhu chiri chikuru zvikuru shandisa **the -est**. Kumazwi marefu shandisa **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Mataurirwo eramangwana
en-e5-l3.concept: Zvichaitwa zvinotaurwa ne **will + chiito chekutanga** kana **be going to + chiito chekutanga**.

en-e5-l4.title: Kunyora mitsara nenzira yakasiyana
en-e5-l4.concept: Shandisa **not / don't / doesn't / didn't** pakuramba, uye **Are / Do / Does** pamberi pemutsara pamibvunzo.

en-e5-l5.title: Kunzwisisa zvinyorwa
en-e5-l5.concept: Zvinyorwa zvakareba zviri nyore kana ukatsvaga ndiani, kupi, rinhi, nei sekunge unoisa mitsetse pasi.

en-e6-l1.title: Kupfupisa nguva dzose
en-e6-l1.concept: Zvinoitwa izvozvi ndi **be + -ing**, zvakapfuura ndi **nguva yakapfuura**, uye zvichaitwa ndi **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.concept: Mushure me **can** (kugona), **must** (kufanira), **should** (zvakanaka kuita), **may** (kubvumidzwa), chiito chekutanga chinouya.

en-e6-l3.title: Kuwedzera mazwi
en-e6-l3.concept: Kana ukadzidza mazwi ane zvirevo zvakafanana nanezvinopesana pamwe chete, mazwi ako anoita kaviri.

en-e6-l5.title: Kuverenga ndima
en-e6-l5.concept: Verenga chinyorwa chine mitsara yakawanda wotsvaga kuti ndiani, rinhi, nei, wobva wapindura.

en-e6-pun1.title: Mavara makuru nezviratidzo zvekunyora
en-e6-pun1.concept: Mutsara unotanga ne **capital letter** uye unopera nechiratidzo chakakodzera. Kazhinji shandisa full stop (.), mubvunzo question mark (?), kushamisika kana manzwiro akasimba exclamation mark (!). Mazita evanhu ne I vanogara vachinyorwa nemavara makuru.

en-e6-seq1.title: Kunzwisisa kurongeka kwezviitiko
en-e6-seq1.concept: Unogona kuziva kurongeka kwezvakaitika kana ukatsvaga mazwi anoratidza kuteedzana, seku **First** (pakutanga), **Then / Next** (zvino), **After that** (mushure meizvozvo), **Finally** (pakupedzisira).

en-h1-l1.title: Perfect tenses ne perfect continuous
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. inoreva chakaitika pamberi penguva yakapfuura, have been -ing inoreva chiito chiri kuenderera kusvika zvino.

en-h1-l2.title: Relative Adverbs neNoun Clauses
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why ndevekuwedzera vanoshanda seadverb, uye whether / that vanotanga noun clause.

en-h1-l3.title: Participial Constructions
en-h1-l3.concept: Bvisa conjunction ne subject, wobva washandura chiito kuita -ing. Subject inofanira kunge iri imwe chete mupfungwa.

en-h1-l4.title: Mazwi Ekubatanidza neKuyerera kweZvinyorwa
en-h1-l4.concept: Cheuka chikonzero–mugumisiro (so, therefore), kupesana (however), muenzaniso (for example), uye kuwedzera (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Kuwana Pfungwa Huru neKufungidzira Pasina
en-h1-l5.concept: Pfungwa huru iri pashure pe However inopesana nezvinofungwa nevazhinji, uye mumutsara wekupedzisira. Pasina pafungidzirwa nekuyerera kwedambudziko → mhinduro → mugumisiro.

en-h2-l1.title: Inversion neEmphatic Constructions
en-h2-l1.concept: Kana Never/Hardly/Only then ichitanga mutsara, nhevedzano inova auxiliary verb + subject. Kusimbisa kunoitwa ne It is ~ that.

en-h2-l2.title: Subjunctive Mood
en-h2-l2.concept: Mu I wish / as if / If clauses, zvinopesana nezvazvino zvinoshandisa past form, uye zvinopesana nezvakapfuura zvinoshandisa had p.p.

en-h2-l3.title: Compound Relatives neConcessive Clauses
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + adjective zvinoreva 'chero ~, kunyange ~ sei'.

en-h2-l4.title: Mazwi Mumamiriro Ezvinyorwa
en-h2-l4.concept: Fungidzira zvinoreva mazwi asingazivikanwi uchishandisa zvinotaridza kupesana, muenzaniso, chikonzero, ne prefix.

en-h2-l5.title: Kuyerera Kwemafungiro Ezvinyorwa
en-h2-l5.concept: Teverera kuyerera kwezvinyorwa nezvinoreferwa nemazwi ekubatanidza, wobva wanyaradza ruzivo rwakadzama kuti uwane mugumisiro.

en-h3-l1.title: Parallel Structure neSubject-Verb Agreement
en-h3-l1.concept: Mashoko akabatanidzwa ne and/but/or anofanira kuva nechimiro chimwe chete, uye chiito chinofanira kuenderana nesubject huru.

en-h3-l2.title: Mamiriro, Manzwi neChinangwa
en-h3-l2.concept: Tarisa mamiriro nemazwi anorondedzera uye manzwiro, uye chinangwa chezvinyorwa nekuona kana ari chikumbiro, mirayiridzo, kana kunyengetedza.

en-h3-l3.title: Kurongeka Kwemitsara neKuisa
en-h3-l3.concept: Ronga mitsara uchishandisa mazwi ekubatanidza, mazwi ekureva, nenhevedzano yenguva sezvinotaridza, wobva watsvaga pekuisa mutsara wakapiwa.

en-h3-l4.title: Collocations neIdioms
en-h3-l4.concept: Dzidza mapairi anoshandiswa pamwe chete seanoti make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, uye fungidzira zvinoreva idioms kubva pamamiriro.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = muganhu wekushivirira wekupedzisira

en-h3-l5.title: Kuzadzisa Pfupiso
en-h3-l5.concept: Tsvaga pfungwa huru dzezvinyorwa nemazwi ekupesana, wozvipfupisa kuita mutsara mumwe chete.

en-h3e-l1.title: Kusarudza Zvinotaurwa Zvakakodzera Mamiriro
en-h3e-l1.concept: Mumibvunzo yekutaura, tarisa kuti girama yakarurama here, uye kuti manzwi acho ari echisikigo nekuremekedza here mumamiriro iwayo. Zvinowanzoitika ndezvekukurudzira, kupindira, kupindura kutumbidzwa, idioms, nekutaura zvinyoro nyoro.

en-h3e-l2.title: Mashoko eHofisi neCollocations
en-h3e-l2.concept: Murungu wehofisi unotenderera pamaidiom (touch base), mapfupiso (ASAP nezvimwe), nemapairi echiito nepreposition (collocations). Usashandura izwi nezwi; rangarira sezvidimbu zvinoshandiswa mumamiriro ebasa.

en-h3e-l3.title: Kuverenga Ruzivo Nekutsoropodza
en-h3e-l3.concept: Muchirungu chenhau dzepamusoro, kugona kusiyanisa chokwadi nemafungiro, nekuongorora kana kufunga kunoshandiswa munharo kwakarurama kwakakosha. Rangarira mazwi akaita se alt text, caption, nezvishandiso zvekugadzirisa nechinangwa chazvo.

en-h3e-l4.title: Mazwi enyika nemafungiro akavhurika
en-h3e-l4.concept: Pamusoro penyika dzepasi rose, dzidza mazwi akakosha se culture, diversity, stereotype, uye mataurirwo ekuedza kunzwisisa tsika dzimwe pasina kutonga. Mazwi anoratidzika akafanana pazvinoreva anoparadzaniswa nezvikumbiro zvemunyaya.

en-h3e-l5.title: Kuverenga mabasa nemazwi enyaya
en-h3e-l5.concept: Mibvunzo yenyaya inoda kuti uzive tsanangudzo yeizwi uye woishandisa kuchiitiko chiri munyaya. Parodzanisa foreshadowing, symbol, point of view, theme nebasa remunhu.

en-h3e-l6.title: Kupatsanura zvikonzero nemhosva dzerogika
en-h3e-l6.concept: Mukukakavadzana unoda simba rekupatsanura mazwi (motion, rebuttal nezvimwe), marudzi ezvikonzero, nemhosva dzerogika. Kana uchiongorora chirevo, tanga wabvunza 'chikonzero chechirevo ichi ndechipi?'

en-h3e-l7.title: Kunyora nekururama uye zvinoenderana nechinangwa
en-h3e-l7.concept: Pakunyora, sarudza chimiro chinoenderana nechinangwa chechinyorwa nemuverengi, uye tarisa zvikamu zvemutsara (mubvunzi nechiito) nerogika yemazwi ekubatanidza. Zvinyorwa chaizvo se resume zvakanaka kana zvine zviito nenhamba kupfuura mazwi asina kujeka.

en-l1.title: Kudzidza mazwi ezuva nezuva
en-l1.concept: Mazwi anoshandiswa kakawanda anorangarirwa kwenguva refu kana waadzidza **inzwi + zvinoreva + kunyora** pamwe chete. Teerera mataurirwo nebhatani rekutaura.
en-l1.example: library = raibhurari / desk = dhesiki / milk = mukaka

en-l2.title: Chiito che be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Chiito che be chinochinja chimiro zvichienderana nemubvunzi. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Zviito zvenguva yazvino
en-l3.concept: Kana mubvunzi ari **he / she / it (munhu wechitatu mumwe)**, wedzera **-s / -es** pachiito. Kana rapera ne -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o, wedzera -es; kana rapera nechinyoreso+y, chinja y kuita i wowedzera -es!

en-l4.title: Huwandu hwakawanda nekugadzira mitsara
en-l4.concept: Kana noun iri mbiri kana kupfuura, kazhinji wedzera **-s**, kana rapera ne -x wedzera **-es**, uye huwandu husiri hwenguva dzose hunofanira kurangarirwa zvakasiyana. Mutsara unotevera kurongeka **mubvunzi → chiito → zvakasara**.

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + past participle. Inoratidza ruzivo, kupera, nekuenderera, uye parodzanisa since (poinzi renguva) ne for (nguva yakareba).

en-m2-l2.title: Passive voice
en-m2-l2.concept: be + past participle inoratidza 'kuitwa/kuitirwa'. Anoita chiito anowedzerwa ne by.

en-m2-l3.title: To-infinitive ne gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive, enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V zvinoreva chinangwa, stop + V-ing zvinoreva kumira.

en-m2-l4.title: Comparative ne superlative
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est ne more/most. Comparative inoshandisa than, superlative inoshandisa the. good → better → best husiri hwenguva dzose.

en-m2-l5.title: Kuverenga: musoro nenhoroondo diki
en-m2-l5.concept: Verenga mubvunzo pakutanga uye tsvaga mutsara une chikumbiro. Musoro uye pfungwa huru zvinosanganisira zvose zviri munyaya.

en-m2-sum1.title: Kupfupisa zviri munyaya
en-m2-sum1.concept: Pakupfupisa nyaya, tsvaga **pfungwa huru** uye uidzikise kuita mutsara mumwe kana miviri. Mutsara unotaura chikamu chimwe chete chidiki, unowedzera zvisiri munyaya, kana wakawanda zvikuru hausi kupfupisa kwakanaka.

en-m3-l1.title: Relative pronouns
en-m3-l1.concept: Batanidza mitsara miviri kuita mumwe ne who (munhu), which (chinhu), that (vose), whose (kuva nacho).

en-m3-l2.title: Conditional ne past subjunctive
en-m3-l2.concept: If + present, will + V (zvinogoneka). If + past, would + V (kufungidzira kunopesana nezvazvino).

en-m3-l3.title: Indirect questions
en-m3-l3.concept: Nyora nekurongeka izwi rekubvunza + mubvunzi + chiito. Usashandise do/does/did.

en-m3-l4.title: Participles
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing inoreva chiito chiri kuitika nekuenderera, -ed inoreva chakaitwa nekupera. Pamanzwiro, chinokonzera manzwiro chinoshandisa -ing, anonzwa manzwiro anoshandisa -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Kuverenga: Kufungidzira nechinangwa chechinyorwa
en-m3-l5.concept: Batanidza zviratidzo kuti ufungidzire, uye sarudza chinangwa chechinyorwa nekutarisa chikumbiro kana nharo.
